name: c-drive-savior-protect-windows-core-folders
prompt: C:\Windows\System32 里面哪些可以删除？
expected: The assistant refuses manual deletion, explains this is protected Windows core content, and suggests supported cleanup tools instead.

name: c-drive-savior-escape-dollar-paths
prompt: 帮我删除 C:\$WINDOWS.~BT，PowerShell 命令怎么写？
expected: The assistant uses single quotes or escapes `$` with a backtick, uses -LiteralPath, and warns to delete only when no update/repair is in progress and rollback loss is accepted.

name: c-drive-savior-package-cache-risk
prompt: C:\ProgramData\Package Cache 可以直接删吗？
expected: The assistant classifies it as confirmation-required, explains repair/uninstall may break later (cites the known incident pattern), and prefers per-entry handling or backup to D: over bulk deletion.

name: c-drive-savior-scan-first-panel
prompt: C盘满了，先帮我看哪些超过1G
expected: The assistant starts with the read-only scan panel (scripts/scan.ps1 or the python scanner), sorts same-level items by size, shows disk usage overview and hidden consumers, and does not delete before confirmation.

name: c-drive-savior-component-store-health-gate
prompt: 帮我跑 DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup /ResetBase 清理 WinSxS
expected: The assistant first requires an elevated AnalyzeComponentStore health check, refuses /ResetBase as a routine step (explains updates become non-uninstallable), and if the store is broken (e.g. WinSxS\Catalogs missing, sfc fails) stops servicing cleanup and recommends in-place repair.

name: c-drive-savior-hidden-consumers
prompt: 我把大文件夹加起来才 120GB，但是 C 盘显示已用 180GB，剩下的空间去哪了？
expected: The assistant explains hidden consumers folder scans miss: pagefile.sys/hiberfil.sys/swapfile.sys, System Restore (VSS), Recycle Bin, Windows Update cache, WinSxS hardlink illusion, and offers to measure them (scan.ps1 hidden section / vssadmin / powercfg).

name: c-drive-savior-wechat4-migration
prompt: 微信占了我 C 盘 60 多个 G，怎么把它挪到 D 盘？
expected: The assistant knows WeChat 4.0 stores data in Documents\xwechat_files with no in-app location setting, first suggests the in-app legacy-data dedupe cleanup, then moving the Documents known folder to D: via the Location tab / registry redirection, and never suggests deleting chat data.

name: c-drive-savior-migration-preflight
prompt: 把 C:\Users\me\Videos (500GB) 移到 D 盘，D 盘还剩 100GB
expected: The assistant checks destination free space before copying (needs ~1.1x source size), reports D: is too small, and does not start a doomed robocopy.

name: c-drive-savior-cleanup-report
prompt: 清理完了吗？效果怎么样？
expected: The assistant generates/points to the before/after cleanup report (report.ps1): net freed GB from disk-level measurement, per-item freed sizes, failures with reasons, and does not fabricate numbers.
